platform Product Design Technology Murata Product Design Technology Murata’s product design technology encompasses a wide range of areas, including sensing, connectivity component, power modules, battery devices, micro mechatronics, and applications/solutions. We pursue safety and high reliability across a broad range of products, from high-performance, compact, and unique components to modules and systems. We emphasize collaboration with technical experts in materials, production, and common technologies as this not only creates industry-leading products but also helps solve customer challenges using simulation and actual measurement evaluation.
